title: June, ca. 240 B.C. Eratosthenes Measures the Earth
authors: American Physical Society, APS News, This Month in Physics History
version: American Physical Society, APS News, This Month in Physics History

passages.quote: Possibly the first to propose a spherical Earth based on actual physical evidence was Aristotle (384-322 B.C.)
until about 240 B.C., when Eratosthenes devised a clever method of estimating its circumference
